arxiv-2111-02795.title: Prime Sums Thanks: DLD was supported by the Simons Collaboration in Arithmetic Geometry, Number Theory, and Computation via the Simons Foundation grant 546235.
arxiv-2111-02795.creator: Anupam Datta, Nir Elber, Raymond Feng, David Lowry-Duda, Henry Xie
arxiv-2111-02795.description: Abstract . We study the properties of certain graphs involving the sums of primes. Their structure largely turns out to relate to the distribution of prime gaps and can be roughly seen in Cramér’s model as well. We also discuss generalizations to the Gaussian integers. 1. Introduction The main motivation is why the following figure has so much structure.

arxiv-2203-16727.title: Mid-Infrared studies of dusty sources in the Galactic Center Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2203-16727.creator: Harshitha K. Bhat, Nadeen B. Sabha, Michal Zajaček, Andreas Eckart, Rainer Schödel, S. Elaheh Hosseini, Florian Peißker, Anton Zensus
arxiv-2203-16727.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Harshitha K. Bhat, Nadeen B. Sabha, Michal Zajaček, Andreas Eckart, Rainer Schödel, S. Elaheh Hosseini, Florian Peißker, Anton Zensus. Mid-Infrared (MIR) images of the Galactic center show extended gas and dust features along with bright IRS sources. Some of these dust features are a part of ionized clumpy streamers orbiting Sgr A*, known as the mini-spiral. We present their proper motions over 12 year time period and report their flux densities in N N -band filters and derive their spectral indices.

arxiv-2205-15711.title: SEARCH FOR ELECTROWEAK PRODUCTION OF CHARGINOS AND NEUTRALINOS IN ALL HADRONIC FINAL STATES AT THE CMS EXPERIMENT
arxiv-2205-15711.creator: ANKUSH REDDY KANUGANTI On behalf of the CMS Collaboration
arxiv-2205-15711.description: Abstract The results from a search for chargino-neutralino or chargino pair production via electroweak interactions are summarized. The results are based on a sample of s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\penalty\ \mathrm{TeV} proton-proton collisions from the LHC, recorded with the CMS detector [ 1 ] and corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 137 ​ fb − 1 137\penalty\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1} .

arxiv-2303-03342.title: Surface viscosity in simple liquids
arxiv-2303-03342.creator: Paolo Malgaretti, Ubaldo Bafile, Renzo Vallauri, Pál Jedlovszky, Marcello Sega
arxiv-2303-03342.description: Abstract The response of Newtonian liquids to small perturbations is usually considered to be fully described by homogeneous transport coefficients like shear and dilatational viscosity. However, the presence of strong density gradients at the liquid/vapor boundary of fluids hints at the possible existence of an inhomogeneous viscosity.

arxiv-2407-20067.title: xAI-Drop: Don’t Use What You Cannot Explain
arxiv-2407-20067.creator: Vincenzo Marco De Luca, Antonio Longa, Pietro Liò, Andrea Passerini
arxiv-2407-20067.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as the predominant paradigm for learning from graph-structured data, offering a wide range of applications from social network analysis to bioinformatics. Despite their versatility, GNNs face challenges such as lack of generalization and poor interpretability, which hinder their wider adoption and reliability in critical applications.

arxiv-2408-09609.title: Behavior of the Position and Ellipticity Angles at Polarization Mode Transitions in Pulsar Radio Emission
arxiv-2408-09609.creator: M. M. McKinnon
arxiv-2408-09609.description: Abstract Polarization observations of radio pulsars show that abrupt transitions in the polarization vector’s position angle can be accompanied by large excursions in the vector’s ellipticity angle, suggesting the vector passes near the right or left circular pole of the Poincaré sphere.

arxiv-2409-02102.title: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques for Statistical Inference in Cosmology
arxiv-2409-02102.creator: Minsu Park, Marco Gatti, Bhuvnesh Jain
arxiv-2409-02102.description: Abstract We explore linear and non-linear dimensionality reduction techniques for statistical inference of parameters in cosmology. Given the importance of compressing the increasingly complex data vectors used in cosmology, we address questions that impact the constraining power achieved, such as: Are currently used methods effectively lossless? Under what conditions do non-linear methods, typically based on neural nets, outperform linear methods?

arxiv-2411-18292.title: A Faster Deterministic Algorithm for Mader’s 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -Path Packing
arxiv-2411-18292.creator: Satoru Iwata, Hirota Kinoshita
arxiv-2411-18292.description: Abstract Given an undirected graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) with a set of terminals T ⊆ V T\subseteq V partitioned into a family 𝒮 \mathcal{S} of disjoint blocks, find the maximum number of vertex-disjoint paths whose endpoints belong to two distinct blocks while no other internal vertex is a terminal.

europmc-pmc9806465.creator: Markus HS, de Leeuw FE.
europmc-pmc9806465.description: Cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) causes lacunar stroke and intracerebral hemorrhage, and is the most common pathology underlying vascular cognitive impairment. Increasingly, the importance of other clinical features of SVD is being recognized including motor impairment,...

pmc-10586856.title: ABC-AF-Stroke score predicts thromboembolism in non-anticoagulated patients following successful atrial fibrillation ablation: a report from the Chinese Atrial Fibrillation Registry
pmc-10586856.creator: Yufeng Wang, Chao Jiang, Liu He, Xin Du, Xueyuan Guo, Ribo Tang, Caihua Sang, Deyong Long, Jianzeng Dong, Ziad Hijazi, Gregory Y.H. Lip, Changsheng Ma
pmc-10586856.description: Background:The age, biomarkers, and clinical history (ABC)-atrial fibrillation (AF)-Stroke score have been proposed to refine stroke risk stratification, beyond what clinical risk scores such as the CHA2DS2-VASc score can offer. This study aimed to identify risk factors associated with thromboembolism and evaluate the performance of the ABC-AF-Stroke score in predicting thromboembolism in non-anticoagulated AF patients following successful ablations.

pmc-11421523.title: Promoting mental health in the workplace: web software development and validation *
pmc-11421523.creator: Evelin Daiane Gabriel Pinhatti, Regina Celia Bueno Rezende Machado, Rosangela Aparecida Pimenta, André Estevam Jaques, Maria do Carmo Fernandez Lourenço Haddad, Evelin Daiane Gabriel Pinhatti, Regina Celia Bueno Rezende Machado, Rosangela Aparecida Pimenta, André Estevam Jaques, Maria do Carmo Ferna
pmc-11421523.description: Objective to develop and validate the content and technical aspects of a web software program for promoting mental health in the workplace. Method: applied methodological study and technological development, carried out in three stages: 1) Umbrella review development; 2) Web software development; 3) Content and technical validation carried out by 14 judges.

pmc-11433559.title: Clinical Characteristics of Candidemia Due to Candida parapsilosis with Serial Episodes: Insights from 5-Year Data Collection at a Tertiary Hospital in Korea
pmc-11433559.creator: Eun Jeong Won, Heungsup Sung, Mi-Na Kim, Arianna Tavanti
pmc-11433559.description: Candida parapsilosis is a common cause of non-albicans Candida species causing candidemia, particularly invasive candidiasis. This study aimed to characterize candidemia due to the C. parapsilosis complex with serial episodes, including clinical and mycological features. Methods: Blood isolates of the C. parapsilosis complex were collected from February 2019 to January 2023 at a tertiary Korean hospital.

pmc-11479108.title: Preparations of Polyurethane Foam Composite (PUFC) Pads Containing Micro-/Nano-Crystalline Cellulose (MCC/NCC) toward the Chemical Mechanical Polishing Process
pmc-11479108.creator: Yi-Shen Huang, Yu-Wen Huang, Qiao-Wen Luo, Chao-Hsing Lin, Penjit Srinophakun, Supanicha Alapol, Kun-Yi Andrew Lin, Chih-Feng Huang
pmc-11479108.description: Polyurethane foam (PUF) pads are widely used in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP). This study prepares PUF composites with microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) and nanocrystalline cellulose (NCC) to improve CMP performance. MCC and NCC were characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD), showing average diameters of 129.7 ± 30.9 nm for MCC and 22.

pmc-11641044.title: A Simple Narrative Review of Progress on the Processing and Utilization of Functional Rice
pmc-11641044.creator: Ziying Yi, Dagang Chen, Xinqiao Zhou, Jie Guo, Ke Chen, Chanjuan Ye, Chuanguang Liu, Juan Liu, Marcio Schmiele
pmc-11641044.description: This paper aims to review the research progress on the processing and utilization of functional rice and explore its potential to enhance human health. The research progress in the processing and utilization of colored rice, low-protein rice, high-resistant starch rice, micronutrient-enriched rice, and bioreactor rice was systematically analyzed through a comprehensive literature review.

pmc-11646438.title: The Role of Mechanosensitive Piezo Channels in Chronic Pain
pmc-11646438.creator: Yantong Wan, Jieshu Zhou, Hao Li
pmc-11646438.description: Purpose of ReviewMechanosensitive Piezo channels are ion channels activated by mechanical stimuli, playing a crucial role in mechanotransduction processes and mechanical hypersensitivity. When these channels are subjected to mechanical loading, membrane currents rise instantaneously, depolarizing and activating voltage-gated calcium channels. This results in an increase in intracellular Ca2+, which contributes to heightened sensitivity to mechanical stimuli.

pmc-11669965.title: Endoscopic ultrasound guided-gastroenterostomy is the best choice in the treatment of gastric outlet obstruction
pmc-11669965.creator: Mateusz Jagielski
pmc-11669965.description: First of all, I would like to congratulate Vilas-Boas et al on an interesting publication. In this letter the authors write about very interesting topics in the management of patients with malignant gastric outlet obstruction (GOO). GOO developed in up to 20% of patients with advanced hepatopancreatobiliary disease both in benign and malignant form.

pmc-11676406.title: Novel Flavin Mononucleotide-Functionalized Cerium Fluoride Nanoparticles for Selective Enhanced X-Ray-Induced Photodynamic Therapy
pmc-11676406.creator: Anastasia I Kornienko, Maria A Teplonogova, Marina P Shevelyova, Matvei A Popkov, Anton L Popov, Vladimir E Ivanov, Nelli R Popova, Zhengqing Guo
pmc-11676406.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). X-ray-induced photodynamic therapy (X-PDT) represents a promising new method of cancer treatment. A novel type of nanoscintillator based on cerium fluoride (CeF3) nanoparticles (NPs) modified with flavin mononucleotide (FMN) has been proposed. A method for synthesizing CeF3-FMN NPs has been developed, enabling the production of colloidal, spherical NPs with an approximate diameter of 100 nm, low polydispersity, and a high fluorescence quantum yield of 0.42. It has been demonstrated that CeF3-FMN NPs exhibit pH-dependent radiation-induced redox activity when exposed to X-rays.

pmc-11704534.title: Outcomes after open repair of aortic aneurysms and dissections in cannabis consumers
pmc-11704534.creator: Lucas Ribé Bernal, Akiko Tanaka, Yuki Ikeno, Rana O Afifi, Harleen K Sandhu, Charles C Miller, Anthony L Estrera
pmc-11704534.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the influence of cannabis consumption on the mid- and long-term surgical outcomes of patients with aortic aneurysms or dissections.MethodsAll individuals aged 18 years and older with more than 6 months of cannabis use at the time of surgical repair for cardiovascular disease (aortic aneurysms or aortic dissection) between 2007 and 2023 were eligible.

pmc-12611349.title: Biodiversity and Conservation of Marine Mollusks in the Indo‐Pacific Convergence Zone
pmc-12611349.creator: Xianshui Lai, Tingting Li, Bailin Cong, Pipit Pitriana, Bei Wang, Linlin Zhao, Shenghao Liu
pmc-12611349.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The Indo‐Pacific Convergence Zone (IPCZ), a global marine biodiversity hotspot, faces increasing threats from anthropogenic activities and climate change. This study presents the first comprehensive assessment of mollusk diversity, identifies conservation gaps, and prioritizes protection areas in the IPCZ. Using 47,097 occurrence records of 3215 mollusk species, along with habitat and environmental data, we mapped biodiversity indices and integrated Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) and fishing effort.

pmc-12737650.title: Marine Biotoxins in Crustaceans and Fish—A Review
pmc-12737650.creator: Anna Madejska, Jacek Osek
pmc-12737650.description: In recent years, there has been an increase in the consumption of seafood such as shellfish and crustaceans due to their pleasant taste and nutritional value. Fish are also a crucial part of a healthy, balanced diet. However, the consumption of these products may cause food poisoning through marine biotoxins.

pmc-13300110.title: Early rhythm control promotes ventricular recovery and reduces ICD requirement in idiopathic LVSD with arrhythmia under WCD protection
pmc-13300110.creator: J Yogarajah, J Dannenbaum, A Halim, M Mensch, M Kuniss, T Neumann, J Treiber, S Sossalla, A Hain
pmc-13300110.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSustained arrhythmias can precipitate left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD), which may improve after rhythm stabilization. In patients with newly diagnosed idiopathic LVSD, distinguishing reversible dysfunction from persistent cardiomyopathy is crucial for clinical management and ICD decision-making.ObjectiveTo evaluate the impact of early rhythm control on left ventricular functional response and ICD indication in patients with idiopathic LVSD and arrhythmia under wearable cardioverter-defibrillator (WCD) protection.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 780 consecutive WCD-treated patients (2017–2023).

pmc-13303586.title: Germanium-embedded fabrics attenuate oxidative stress and modulate cytokine activity in a progressive in vitro model of endothelial dysfunction
pmc-13303586.creator: Saveria Batti, Erwin Pavel Lamparelli, Mariacristina Arianna, Federica Montella, Gina Myers, Nicola Maffulli, Giovanna Della Porta

pmc-13355633.title: Identification of an Immunotherapy-Associated CD1c+CLEC10A+ Dendritic Cell Subset and Development of a Prognostic Model in Breast Cancer
pmc-13355633.creator: Zi-An Xia, Jiang He
pmc-13355633.description: PurposeUnderstanding which immune cell populations are linked to immunotherapy efficacy is essential for improving treatment stratification in breast cancer. This study aimed to identify immune-relevant cellular subsets from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data and to develop a prognostic model based on genes characteristic of the relevant population.

pmc-13471357.title: Associations between polygenic risk for obesity, body mass index and cognitive performance: Age as moderating factor
pmc-13471357.creator: Mathilda Recht, Kathrin Finke, Marius Gruber, Andreas J. Forstner, Janik Goltermann, Maike Richter, Benjamin Straube, Elisabeth Schrammen, Moritz Rau, Jonathan Repple, Kira Flinkenflügel, Judith Krieger, Anna Kraus, Elisabeth J. Leehr, Tiana Borgers, Tilo Kircher, Udo Dannlowski, Nils Opel
pmc-13471357.description: Obesity has been associated with cognitive impairment, yet the contribution of obesity-related genetic liability to cognition across the lifespan remains unclear.Here, we investigated associations between body mass index (BMI), obesity polygenic risk score (PRS), and cognitive performance in 796 individuals from the FOR2107 Marburg-Münster Affective Disorders Cohort Study (MACS).

pmc-13532661.title: Adaptation of eukaryotic membrane homeostasis to species-specific cellular lipid landscapes
pmc-13532661.creator: Elisa Gomez-Gil, Paolo Guerra, Ying Gu, Sherman Foo, Benedicte Billard, Gabor Balogh, Maria Peter, Snezhana Oliferenko
pmc-13532661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this study, Gomez-Gil et al. describe a mechanistic paradigm that contributes to the maintenance of membrane lipid homeostasis in fission yeast. A critical sensor domain in the membrane-bound transcriptional activator Mga2 dictates its dynamic range of activation, but cis-regulatory elements that control the baseline expression of its target, Δ9-desaturase OLE1, can redefine the dynamic range of Mga2 activation and fine-tune membrane lipid unsaturation.

pmc-13587539.title: Six decades of trends in BMI, thinness, overweight, and obesity among 210,927 Swedish children in different socioeconomic contexts
pmc-13587539.creator: Maria Bygdell, Klara Hemmed, Jari Martikainen, Carl Bonander, Lovisa Sjögren, Claes Ohlsson, Jenny M Kindblom
pmc-13587539.description: BackgroundChildhood obesity and low socioeconomic status increase the risk for adverse health outcomes. Societal changes may have altered the association between parental socioeconomic factors and childhood obesity over time. Our aim was to evaluate the trends for BMI in girls and boys 1952–2017 and the importance of socioeconomic factors for the BMI trend 2002–2017.
